notes: Grid fixed before computing the stopping-policy comparison.
Exact prefix replay: thresholds stop a saved trajectory; they do not alter the next question if continuation is permitted.
Information gain matches managed runtime; random uses the selected random question gain as a declared control, not a runtime policy.
Original-report simulated answers only. Outcome part is used only downstream for scoring.
All-attribute questions can reuse narrative information; structured-only and coded-only controls retained.
No production activation or held-out access.

interval: 95% percentile bootstrap by original report; undefined answered accuracy retains null and valid-resample count.
unsupported_definition: Answered cases whose correction part is outside the terminal top three, divided by all cases; outcome-key proxy, not sentence hallucination.
question_burden_definition: Mean applied questions over all cases, including eventual abstentions.
